description: Registry for the visual corpus audit (DS020, /audit). The audit page has four tabs (owner decision 2026-09-30): `bad_english`, `symbolic_english` and `neuro_english`, the three datasets of datasets/ (DS008 "Three datasets"), and a fourth, clearly secondary `archive` tab that holds the legacy corpora of datasets_archive/, the sealed legacy suites of eval/suites/ and the read-only local source cache datasets_sources/new_cases. `tabs` names each tab and states its purpose; `corpora` types a corpus explicitly (a dataset type equals its tab; legacy corpora keep their earlier review types formalizer, proofreading and cleanText, all shown in the archive tab); `patterns` and `default_type` classify an unlisted name; `extra_files` lists split files the directory scan would not find.

clean-english.note: Clean-English formalization corpus (message -> DS021 SOP target); a formalizer corpus, not the cleanText/textToCleanEnglish step.

proofing.note: proofing/proofreader/{train,dev}.jsonl is a flat {prompt,target} training projection of the same rows (no semantic_case_id); it is intentionally not reviewed as a separate split here.

proofing-diverse-dev.note: Only the v2-additions-*.jsonl files are proofing-schema rows (input/target/kind). diverse-dev.jsonl, candidates.jsonl and teacher-variants.jsonl in the same directory are DS022 diversity-generator build artifacts for formalizer-v1 (question/family/sop rows, or raw paraphrase pools with no case id), out of scope for this audit; they are not read here.

bad_english.note: test-composed is the sealed composed evaluation suite (tools/eval/composed-suites.mjs, view only); incoming holds production cases pending review (tools/datasets/add-case.mjs).

symbolic_english.note: test-composed is the sealed composed evaluation suite (tools/eval/composed-suites.mjs, view only); incoming holds production cases pending review (tools/datasets/add-case.mjs).

neuro_english.note: test-composed is the sealed composed evaluation suite (tools/eval/composed-suites.mjs, view only); incoming holds production cases pending review (tools/datasets/add-case.mjs).

clean_text_sources.label: New cases (writer drafts, textToCleanEnglish)
clean_text_sources.note: Local source cache (AGENTS.md rule 10, DS014-source-rights.md): datasets_sources/ is never exported. Collected per new_cases.md; not yet a train/dev/test corpus. Shown read-only in the cleanText tab so a reviewer can browse and spot-check the writer drafts before tools/datasets/build-new-cases.mjs assembles datasets_sources/new_cases/cases.jsonl.

tabs.label: bad_english
tabs.purpose: Messages that are not clean English: Romanian, mixed Romanian/English, spelling and grammar problems, garbled text. Where an acceptable clean-English rewrite is known, the row carries it as the target. Material to evaluate, and only after the owner's approval fine-tune, LanguageProofingLLM (the model behind textToCleanEnglish; currently Qwen3-1.7B plus LanguageTool). Review the kind (ro, mixed, noisy_en), the noise categories and whether the clean target is really clean English that parses.

tabs.label: symbolic_english
tabs.purpose: Correct English that SymbolicLM (Stanza analysis plus the UD-to-SOP rules) analyses correctly. Each row stores the message, SymbolicLM's grammatical analysis and the SOP Lang it produced. This is the regression suite (tools/symbolic-regression.mjs) and the inventory of target forms for SymbolicProofingLLM. Review whether the analysis is right; re-run SymbolicLM on a row to see whether the current engine still gives the same analysis.

tabs.label: neuro_english
tabs.purpose: Correct English that SymbolicLM does not analyse correctly. Rows carry the failure kind (parser, rules, gold_convention, unknown) with blame details, what SymbolicLM produced against the gold, and, where known, a meaning-preserving rewrite that SymbolicLM handles. Material to evaluate, and only after the owner's approval fine-tune, SymbolicProofingLLM. The priority is to fix SymbolicLM with rules and repairs; rewrite only what rules cannot fix.

tabs.label: archive / sources
tabs.purpose: Secondary view, not a dataset of the current plan. Legacy corpora (datasets_archive/: formalizer-v1, proofing, proofing-diverse-dev, clean-english), their sealed suites in eval/suites/, and the read-only local source cache datasets_sources/new_cases (never exported). They are provenance and earlier work; results on them live in the archive and history reports.
